# A round hay bale lying on its side (axis X), 1.0 m across, 0.9 m long. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Hay --base-color 0.9686 0.8941 0.4627 --no-slot
material new HayEnd --base-color 0.6078 0.6118 0.5098 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Bale --vertices 10 --radius 0.5 --depth 0.9 --location 0 0 0.5 --rotation 0 90 0
material assign Hay
active Bale
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.x) > 0.9"
material assign HayEnd
mode object
select all
shade flat
export haybale.glb
